[[Battle Arcade]] }} '''Tackling Togekiss''' (Japanese: '''VS トゲキッス''' ''VS Togekiss''), titled '''VS Togekiss''' in the [[Chuang Yi]] translation, is the 423rd chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the seventh chapter of the {{MangaArc|Platinum}}. It is subtitled '''The Swapping Panel''' (Japanese: '''取り換えっこのパネル''' ''Exchange Panel'') in the [[VIZ Media]] translation and '''Panel of Mutual Exchange''' in the Chuang Yi translation. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} At the [[Pokémon Association]] headquarters, [[Bertha]], [[Aaron]], and [[Lucian]] are poring over [[Charon]]'s memo, which is a list of all the {{pkmn2|Legendary}} and [[Mythical Pokémon]] in the [[Sinnoh]] region. Bertha wonders what he wants with all of the Pokémon and Lucian and Aaron agree that he wants to capture them to rule the region. Meanwhile at the hospital, {{adv|Diamond}} and {{adv|Pearl}} are with all of the injured [[Gym Leader]]s injured, most notably [[Crasher Wake]]. Diamond gives Pearl a music player that Crasher Wake gave the nurse to give to Pearl. The music player has a theme song for Pearl, that Crasher Wake promised to make him. Pearl begins to cry, and then quickly apologizes. The two of them then decide to check on {{adv|Platinum}}'s Pokémon, who are supposed to be being healed by a famous doctor. They meet [[Daisy Oak]] healing the Pokémon and [[Bebe]], who suggests that once the Pokémon are healed they should be placed in a box for Platinum. Daisy questions whether Platinum has the skill necessary to handle the gift Pokémon from Gym Leaders, and Pearl vehemently defends her ability as a Trainer. Following this, Diamond and Pearl leave to make an appointment with someone they don't know. They meet with a man that they don't recognize, who seems to know them. However, when he puts a statue in front of his face, they remember him as the voice that spoke to them during each of Platinum's [[Gym]] battles, and that his name is Chairman. The Chairman reveals that three of the [[Elite Four]] of Sinnoh have been working on the Charon memo and that they decoded it with the help of {{adv|Professor Oak}}. Diamond questions where the final member of the Elite Four is, and the Chairman informs him that they don't always work as a team. They then put on their new [[Pokétch]]es and set off. The Chairman begins to follow, to their confusion. They decide to take him and [[Dr. Footstep]] along, creating a quartet. At [[Battle Arcade]], Platinum has just finished her 20th battle, with the next one being against the [[Frontier Brain]] [[Dahlia]]. While attempting to stop the roulette on paralysis, a shock goes through the earth and jolts her so she can't press the button within the time limit. Dahlia then gets the right to stop the roulette, and stops it on the Swap tile. The Trainers have to switch Pokémon. Platinum and Dahlia then [[trade]] Pokémon. ==Major events== * {{adv|Diamond}}, {{adv|Pearl}}, [[Dr. Footstep]], and the Sinnoh [[Pokémon Association]] Chairman set out on their journey. * {{adv|Platinum}} continues her [[Battle Arcade]] challenge. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== * [[Aaron]] * [[Bertha]] * [[Lucian]] * Sinnoh [[Pokémon Association]] Chairman ====Pokémon debuts==== ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Diamond}} * {{adv|Pearl}} * {{adv|Platinum}} * {{adv|Looker}} * [[Professor Rowan]] (flashback) * [[Roark]] * [[Gardenia]] * [[Maylene]] * [[Crasher Wake]] * [[Fantina]] * [[Candice]] * [[Aaron]] * [[Bertha]] * [[Lucian]] * [[Dahlia]] * [[Charon]] (flashback) * [[Daisy Oak]] * [[Buck]] (flashback) * [[Dr. Footstep]] * [[Bebe]] * Sinnoh [[Pokémon Association]] Chairman ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Munchlax}} ({{adv|Lax}}; {{adv|Diamond}}'s) * {{p|Chatot}} ([[Chatler]]/{{tt|Chahiko|Chuang Yi}}; {{adv|Pearl}}'s) * {{p|Rapidash}} ({{OP|Platinum|Rapidash}}) * {{p|Empoleon}} ({{OP|Platinum|Empoleon}}) * {{p|Lopunny}} ({{OP|Platinum|Lopunny}}) * {{p|Froslass}} ({{OP|Platinum|Froslass}}) * {{p|Cherrim}} ({{adv|Platinum}}'s; {{form|Cherrim|Overcast Form}}) * {{p|Pachirisu}} ({{adv|Platinum}}'s) * {{p|Drapion}} ([[Aaron]]'s) * {{p|Girafarig}} ([[Lucian]]'s) * {{p|Hippowdon}} ([[Bertha]]'s) * {{p|Ludicolo}} ([[Dahlia]]'s) * {{p|Medicham}} ([[Dahlia]]'s) * {{p|Togekiss}} ([[Dahlia]]'s) * {{p|Cherubi}} (Trainer's) * {{p|Misdreavus}} (Trainer's) * {{p|Riolu}} (Trainer's) * {{p|Bibarel}} (Trainer's) * {{p|Drifloon}} ==Trivia== ===Errors=== * In one panel, {{adv|Pearl}}'s sleeves are unfolded before he is shown unfolding them.
